MODULES_COMPLETE.topic_mastery_notes: Covers: greet, self-introduce, introduce a third party by name, ask/give name, ask follow-up (origin, first day), request (show the way / spell a name), clarify (repeat name), offer/accept, confirm details, close naturally. Sufficient for Pre-A1.1 — negotiation, paraphrase, and unexpected-input handling are not yet in scope at this CEFR stage (see Rule 14).

Source DGE0011-0020 was isolated spelling-drill content (spell this name / spell this word) with no real situation. Reframed as genuine information-checking situations across varied real contexts (phone booking, cafe order, voice chat, library sign-up, vet booking, shop order correction, phone-line mishearing, unfamiliar word, email double-check, peer test practice) so spelling/confirming is absorbed through communication rather than taught as an isolated drill (Rule 12). Covers: request, spell/confirm on request, correct a misunderstanding, ask for repetition, clarify, close naturally.
